claude-replay

Turn AI coding sessions into interactive, shareable HTML replays.

Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kimi Code, and Hermes Agent transcripts. Single self-contained HTML file, zero dependencies.

npm install -g claude-replay
GitHub

Try it online

📄

Drop a .jsonl session file here or click to browse

or load a demo session

Tip: session files are in hidden folders. Press Cmd+Shift+. (macOS), Ctrl+H (Linux), or enable "Show hidden items" (Windows) in the file picker.

Export

For full editing — exclude turns, add bookmarks, edit prompts — install the CLI and run claude-replay to launch the desktop editor.

Features

Multi-format

Supports Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kimi Code, and Hermes Agent transcripts. Auto-detected.

Self-contained

Single HTML file with no external dependencies. Email it, host it, embed it.

Web Editor

Built-in editor to browse sessions, edit prompts, exclude turns, and add bookmarks.

Interactive Player

Playback with speed control, keyboard shortcuts, diff views, and chapter navigation.

Themes

6 built-in themes plus custom theme support with full CSS override.

Docker

Run in a container with read-only session mounts for sandboxed usage.

Privacy

Everything runs locally. Automatic secret redaction for API keys, tokens, and secrets.

GitHub · npm · Community tool — not affiliated with Anthropic
